mapper.select: SELECT ID, MODEL_ID, MASTER_RECORD_ID, STATUS, VALID_FLAG FROM QUALITY_ISSUE WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT ID, ISSUE_ID, QUALITY_RULE_ID, MODEL_COLUMN_ID, STATUS, VALID_FLAG, LAST_CHECK_INSTANCE_ID, LAST_FOUND_TIME FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_INFO WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE QUALITY_ISSUE SET STATUS = '1', UPDATE_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATER_ID = #{userId}, UPDATE_BY = #{userName} WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 AND STATUS = '2' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_INFO d JOIN QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK t ON t.ID = d.TASK_ID AND t.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE d.ISSUE_ID = #{id} AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, ISSUE_ID, QUALITY_RULE_ID, STATUS, VALID_FLAG, LAST_CHECK_INSTANCE_ID, LAST_FOUND_TIME FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_INFO WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND QUALITY_RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ID, TASK_NO, TASK_NAME, MODEL_ID, MODEL_VERSION, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS, REQUIREMENT, RECTIFICATION_TIME, VALID_FLAG, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATER_ID, UPDATE_TIME, REMARK FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK SET STATUS = '1', UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime}, UPDATER_ID = #{updaterId}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy} WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 AND STATUS = '5'
UPDATE QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK SET STATUS = '5', UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime}, UPDATER_ID = #{updaterId}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy} WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 AND STATUS IN ('1', '2')
mapper.sql: t.ID, t.TASK_NO, t.TASK_NAME, t.PRIORITY, t.MODEL_ID, t.MODEL_VERSION, t.ASSIGNEE_ID, t.STATUS, t.REQUIREMENT, t.RECTIFICATION_TIME, t.VALID_FLAG, t.DEL_FLAG, t.CREATE_BY, t.CREATOR_ID, t.CREATE_TIME, t.UPDATE_BY, t.UPDATER_ID, t.UPDATE_TIME, t.REMARK

choose.when: ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.RECTIFICATION_TIME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.RECTIFICATION_TIME ASC, t.ID ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.RECTIFICATION_TIME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.RECTIFICATION_TIME DESC, t.ID DESC
ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME ASC, t.ID ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME DESC, t.ID DESC

mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID AS ID, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_RECORD_ID) AS MASTER_DATA_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS ISSUE_DATA_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_ISSUE_COUNT FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND TASK_ID IN #{taskId} GROUP BY TASK_ID
SELECT QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_ID AS ID, MAX(CREATE_TIME) AS LAST_HANDLED_TIME FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_LOG WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_ID IN #{taskId} GROUP BY QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_ID

SELECT d.ISSUE_INFO_ID AS ID, d.ID AS TASK_INFO_ID, d.ISSUE_ID, q.ISSUE_CODE, d.QUALITY_RULE_ID, d.MASTER_RECORD_ID, i.MODEL_COLUMN_ID, d.STATUS AS TASK_STATUS, i.FAIL_REASON, d.RECTIFICATION_TIME AS RECTIFICATION_TIME, d.REQUIREMENT AS REQUIREMENT, d.UPDATE_BY AS UPDATE_BY, d.UPDATER_ID AS UPDATER_ID FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK_INFO d LEFT JOIN QUALITY_ISSUE q ON q.ID = d.ISSUE_ID AND q.DEL_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN QUALITY_ISSUE_INFO i ON i.ID = d.ISSUE_INFO_ID AND i.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE d.TASK_ID = #{id} AND d.DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY d.ISSUE_ID, d.ID
SELECT t.STATUS AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_TASK t WHERE GROUP BY t.STATUS
SELECT MODEL_COLUMN_ID FROM QUALITY_ISSUE_INFO WHERE ID = #{issueInfoId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0
